# rcartocolor

The goal of `rcartocolor` is to provide color schemes for maps and other
graphics designed by [CARTO](https://carto.com/) as described at
<https://carto.com/carto-colors/>.

## Installation

Get the released version from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("rcartocolor")
```

Get the development version from github:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Nowosad/rcartocolor")
```

## Examples

Display a CARTOcolor palette:

``` r

library(rcartocolor)
display_carto_pal(7, "Vivid")
```

![](reference/figures/README-example-1.png)

Create a CARTOcolor palette:

``` r

my_colors = carto_pal(7, "Burg")
my_colors
#> [1] "#FFC6C4" "#F4A3A8" "#E38191" "#CC607D" "#AD466C" "#8B3058" "#672044"
```

[Browse all 34
palettes](https://jakubnowosad.com/rcartocolor/articles/palettes.html)
to compare swatches and available sizes by palette type.

Display all of the CARTOcolor palettes:

``` r

display_carto_all()
```

![](reference/figures/README-example3-1.png)

[Only display colorblind friendly
palettes](https://jakubnowosad.com/colorblindcheck/articles/check_rcartocolor.html):

``` r

display_carto_all(colorblind_friendly = TRUE)
```

![](reference/figures/README-example4-1.png)

### **ggplot2**

The **rcartocolor** package contains four **ggplot2** color scales: two
for continuous data - `scale_fill_carto_c`, `scale_color_carto_c` and
two for discrete data - `scale_fill_carto_d`, `scale_color_carto_d`:

``` r

library(sf)
#> Linking to GEOS 3.14.1, GDAL 3.12.4, PROJ 9.8.1; sf_use_s2() is TRUE
library(spData)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(world, aes(fill = lifeExp)) +
        geom_sf(data = world) +
        coord_sf(crs = "+proj=robin") +
        scale_fill_carto_c(name = "Life expectancy: ",
                           type = "diverging", palette = "Earth", direction = -1) +
        theme_void()
```

![](reference/figures/README-examplegg1-1.png)

``` r

ggplot(world, aes(fill = region_un)) +
        geom_sf(data = world) +
        coord_sf(crs = "+proj=robin")  +
        scale_fill_carto_d(name = "Region: ", palette = "Safe") +
        theme_void()
```

![](reference/figures/README-examplegg2-1.png)

# Package index

## Choose a palette

- [`carto_pal()`](https://jakubnowosad.com/rcartocolor/reference/carto_pal.md)
  : CARTOcolor palettes
- [`display_carto_pal()`](https://jakubnowosad.com/rcartocolor/reference/display_carto_pal.md)
  : CARTOcolor palette viewer
- [`display_carto_all()`](https://jakubnowosad.com/rcartocolor/reference/display_carto_all.md)
  : CARTOcolor palettes viewer

## Use with ggplot2

- [`scale_color_carto_c()`](https://jakubnowosad.com/rcartocolor/reference/carto_scale.md)
  [`scale_color_carto_d()`](https://jakubnowosad.com/rcartocolor/reference/carto_scale.md)
  [`scale_colour_carto_c()`](https://jakubnowosad.com/rcartocolor/reference/carto_scale.md)
  [`scale_colour_carto_d()`](https://jakubnowosad.com/rcartocolor/reference/carto_scale.md)
  [`scale_fill_carto_c()`](https://jakubnowosad.com/rcartocolor/reference/carto_scale.md)
  [`scale_fill_carto_d()`](https://jakubnowosad.com/rcartocolor/reference/carto_scale.md)
  : CARTO color scales

## Palette data

- [`cartocolors`](https://jakubnowosad.com/rcartocolor/reference/cartocolors.md)
  : CARTOColors database
- [`metacartocolors`](https://jakubnowosad.com/rcartocolor/reference/metacartocolors.md)
  : CARTOColors database metadata
